verdict.rationale: Publishing robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so this axis applies. The direct probe of the front door at www.sos.state.mn.us found robots.txt absent (HTTP 404), and the landing page itself is a Radware CAPTCHA interstitial for keyless agents. Nothing in the pack shows a robots.txt on mblsportal.sos.mn.gov or any other surface.
